answer: Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the falcon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing.
